name: _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_isTrans
statement: x.IsOrdinal ↔ x.IsTransitive ∧ IsTrans _ (Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x)) where mp h

name: _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_forall_mem_isTransitive
statement: x.IsOrdinal ↔ x.IsTransitive ∧ ∀ y ∈ x, y.IsTransitive where mp h

have_tree.name: hmy
have_tree.body: by simp only [Set.mem_diff, SetLike.mem_coe] at hm; exact hm.1
